Every edge in a battlefield world (stones, roof ridges, cracks, even shadows) turning into glowing white-silver blade lines that all point inward at a horde of beasts, a colossal faint ancient bronze bell silhouette behind them in the sky.

Mountains painted in Chinese ink-wash brush strokes becoming real solid stone peaks as they erupt from the ground around a horde of beasts, ink mist turning into rock with glowing amber seams.
